title: Ace of Diamond Act II Second Season's 2nd Part Announces New Cast Member, October 11 Debut
content:
The staff for Ace of Diamond Act II Second Season , the sequel to the 2019-2020 anime of Yūji Terajima 's Ace of Diamond Act II ( Daiya no A Act II ) manga, revealed the key visual, new cast member, and October 11 debut for its second cours (quarter of a year) on Tuesday.

Daisuke Sakuma will voice Shinichiro Saotome from Inashiro High School:

The anime's second cours will debut on October 11 on TV Tokyo and its affiliates at 5:30 p.m. JST, on AT-X at 9:00 p.m. JST. The anime will also stream on Netflix in Japan right after its broadcast.

Hideaki Ōba ( Kunon the Sorcerer Can See , I'm in Love with the Villainess , Love of Kill ) is the season's director, replacing Mitsuyuki Masuhara , at OLM ( Madhouse animated Ace of Diamond Act II ). Kenji Konuta is returning from the previous three anime in the franchise to oversee the series scripts. Yasukazu Shōji ( Major 2nd chief animation director, Restaurant to Another World (TV 2) character designer) is the current character designer, replacing Minoru Ueda and Satoshi Tasaki . Hajime Hyakkoku is returning from Ace of Diamond Act II to compose the music.

The Ace of Diamond Act II Second Season anime debuted on April 5 on TV Tokyo and its affiliates, and also on AT-X . The anime is also streaming on Netflix in Japan.

Terajima launched the Ace of Diamond manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in 2006. He ended the manga in January 2015, and Kodansha published 47 volumes for the manga. Terajima then launched Ace of Diamond Act II in August 2015, and ended the manga in October 2022. Kodansha published 34 volumes for the sequel manga.

Mad Cave Studios' Nakama Press imprint has licensed the manga and will release it as Ace of the Diamond in English in a 3-in-1 omnibus format, starting with the first omnibus volume on March 23, 2027.

Terajima's original Ace of Diamond baseball manga inspired a television anime that premiered in 2013, and Crunchyroll streamed the 75-episode series as it aired in Japan. Ace of Diamond: Second Season premiered in April 2015, and Crunchyroll also streamed the 51-episode series as it aired.

The Ace of Diamond Act II anime premiered in April 2019 and aired for 52 episodes. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired in Japan.

The Ace of Diamond manga won the shōnen category of the 34th Kodansha Manga Awards in 2010. Kodansha USA Publishing began releasing the manga digitally in English in March 2017 under the title Ace of the Diamond . K MANGA is releasing the Ace of the Diamond Act II manga in English.

The manga has also inspired a series of stage plays.
author: ANN

title: Attack on Titan Day Celebrated With 99 Announcements, New Key Visual, Video, Hajime Isayama Art, YouTube Channel and More
content:
September 9 is being celebrated as the first officially recognized Attack on Titan Day, with the franchise sharing 99 pieces of news from around the world as part of a large anniversary campaign.

The date was officially registered by the Japan Anniversary Association in recognition of September 9, 2009, when Hajime Isayama’s original Attack on Titan manga began serialization. The number nine also has a clear connection to the series with its Nine Titans.

Among the major announcements is a new celebratory illustration drawn by Isayama specifically for Attack on Titan Day .

A separate commemorative visual bringing together all Nine Titans has also been released, alongside a special logo inspired by the Doomsday Titan.

The franchise has also launched its official Attack on Titan YouTube channel, which will feature content including limited-time anime streams and exclusive videos. An anniversary livestream is scheduled for September 9 on the new channel, while you can watch a special video introducing the 9 titans below.

On the manga side, the first 99 chapters of Attack on Titan will be available to read for free through Kodansha’s Magazine Pocket for 99 hours beginning on September 9 at 00:00 JST. New commemorative merchandise is also going on sale through Shonen Magazine Shop, including products featuring the anniversary visual and an original Isayama illustration showing the characters in formal attire.

Several theatrical projects were included among the main announcements as well. Attack on Titan Part 1 -Guren no Yumiya- will return to Japanese theaters on October 23, 2026, with ScreenX, 4DX and ULTRA 4DX presentations. Attack on Titan THE LAST ATTACK will receive the same formats in 2027, marking the film’s first ScreenX release.

Koei Tecmo’s upcoming Attack on Titan 3 also received a new opening animation key visual by MAPPA. The game is scheduled for release on December 10.

The remaining announcements include merchandise, events, international collaborations and screenings. They include new projects with Sanrio Characters, Team Liquid, MSI and ROUND1, additional figures from companies including Good Smile Company, Kotobukiya and MEDICOS ENTERTAINMENT, and Attack on Titan events and product launches across Korea, Taiwan, Thailand, Australia, Europe, Africa and other regions.

The anniversary campaign also included several lighter updates directly from Isayama, ranging from his recent interest in romantic comedy manga to comments about movies, driving, saunas and food.
author: Anime Corner

title: Bleach Final Season Shares New Looks at Ichigo & More Ahead of Anime’s Finale
content:
Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War is fast approaching the anime’s final episode, and some special events coming up have revealed some cool new looks at Ichigo Kurosaki and the others ahead of that grand finale. Bleach fans have been waiting over a decade for the TV anime adaptation to return with a proper adaptation of Tite Kubo’s final arc, and we’ve gotten to see that in action over three hit seasons thus far. But this final season of episodes have been full of the biggest moments yet .

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity has been introducing a ton of big sequences that were never seen in action with the original manga , and that also includes a ton of cool transformations fans have wanted to see come to the anime. As the series gets closer to its end, Bleach has announced two special events coming to Japan later this Fall and has dropped some cool new posters for each to help celebrate. Check them out below.

Bleach’s Final Season Announces New Events for Grand Finale

Opening first in Japan is a special collaboration cafe coming on September 18th in the region, and it will include some exclusive goods that will only be available there. It’s the same for the Bleach SOULGROOVER Summer 2026 event coming on the 21st. It will feature a performance of the anime’s most memorable music with members of the cast in attendance, but unfortunately both events are exclusive to Japan in the meantime. But at least fans can check them out from afar thanks to these cool new visuals showing off I chigo and the others one more time before it all ends .

That ending is coming up very quickly too. Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity has already released seven episodes from the time of this writing, and that means there are only three episodes left before it all wraps up . Fans have been wondering how the anime is going to ultimately stick the landing, however, as there still seem to be plenty of things that the series needs to cover within these few episodes. At the same time, there’s still a hope for even more of the original story moments we’ve seen through the final season so far.

How Is Bleach’s Anime Going to End?

When Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity first began, it seemed like the anime was on a pretty clear shot towards its grand finale. There were only a few chapters of Kubo’s manga left to cover, and we’ve seen those faithfully brought to life before it reached the halfway point. Because once the anime reached the fifth episode, the anime has been adding in some of the biggest changes that fans have seen thus far. The story’s gone in such a wild direction that it’s not quite clear if it will return to the manga’s version of the finale.

It’s now time to catch up with everything that’s happened in Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War so far. You can find the first three seasons of the new anime along with the entirety of the classic TV series run now streaming on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+. The English dub release for the final season has kicked off as well , so there aren’t many excuses to make to keep you from seeing how this one ends.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Switch 2 Remake Game's Videos Reveal November 5 Release
content:
Nintendo revealed during The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct on Tuesday video gameplay for the Nintendo Switch 2 remake for the 1998 Nintendo 64 game The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time , and it announces that the game will launch on November 5. The video previews the new visuals and the opening area Kokiri Forest. The gameplay also previews combat in the first dungeon The Great Deku Tree as well as exploration in the main hub Hyrule Field, Hyrule Castle Town, and Lon Lon Ranch. A new trailer previewed more areas and bosses throughout the entire game, and it also revealed voice acting:

The remake adds traditional camera controls, new motion controls, a proper jump button, and a roll dash action. Players can equip an item to the ZR button, and switch between them in a pop-up menu. A new Threads of Time menu helps players recap the story and recognize the next objective. Unlike the original game, time passes in town. Players can now hum into the Switch 2's microphone to play music in-game. The game also recognizes music from an ocarina that customers can purchase. The game also features added dialogue.

The game features compatibility with the Zelda Notes function in the Nintendo Switch App. Today's Record recaps a player's progress on the app. Gossip Quests functions as a scavenger hunt for points that can be exchanged for ocarina music scores. The scores can be used on the Play Ocarina function on the app. The app also includes an Ocarina of Time Quiz with over 2,000 questions. Rupees earned from the app can be used in-game and vice versa.

New amiibo for Young Link and Young Zelda will ship in 2027. Both will unlock in-game masks for the respective character.

The Direct also confirmed a The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition of the Switch 2 console, and a matching Pro Controller and carrying case, that will ship on October 29.

Finally, the series will get a new concert tour for the 40th anniversary starting in Tokyo on January 23. The tour will then go to North America starting in Chicago on February 22, Europe starting in London on April 3, and Australia beginning in Melbourne on May 13. The Direct stream started with a concert performance:

The remake will launch for Switch 2 in 2026.

The original The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time debuted for N64 in November 1998 in the U.S. and Japan, and in December 1998 in Europe and Australia. It is the fifth mainline game in The Legend of Zelda series, and it is the first game in the franchise to feature 3D graphics. The game has since received rereleases on various systems, including via two collection discs for Nintendo GameCube, the Virtual Console on Nintendo Wii, and the Nintendo Classics app on Nintendo Switch. The game got a remastered edition for Nintendo 3DS titled The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D in June 2011. The 3DS version, as well as one of the collection discs for GameCube, included a version of the game with different dungeons titled The Legend of Zelda : Master Quest based on a Nintendo 64DD title.

The game got a manga adaptation by Akira Himekawa , who has also drawn manga of other games in the franchise , in 2000. Viz Media has released the manga in English.

The Legend of Zelda : Echoes of Wisdom , the first mainline game in the series that stars Zelda as the main playable character, as opposed to Link, launched for Nintendo Switch in September 2024. The top-down game features an artstyle similar to the remake of The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening , which shipped for Switch in September 2019.

The Legend of Zelda : Tears of the Kingdom Switch game debuted in May 2023. The sequel game was previously delayed from 2022 to spring 2023 in order to extend development time. Nintendo released The Legend of Zelda : Breath of the Wild for Switch and Nintendo Wii U in March 2017.

The franchise 's live-action film will open April 30, 2027, a week earlier from its previously planned May 7, 2027 opening date. The May 7, 2027 opening date was itself a delay from the film's original March 26, 2027 opening date. Unlike most games in the series, the film has no subtitle.
author: ANN

title: New Godzilla Minus Zero Trailer Reveals First Full Look at New Sequel – Watch Now
content:
Godzilla Minus Zero is coming to screens worldwide with its highly anticipated sequel later this Fall , and a new trailer is showing off the first full look at what to expect from the big movie. Toho’s Godzilla franchise has reached a new apex as with the celebration of its 70th anniversary, Godzilla Minus One ended up being the most critically and commercially successful film in that long history. So it was no surprise to find out that Toho was quick to come back to screens with an official sequel.

Godzilla Minus Zero has been sharing brief looks at the sequel for the past few months , but they have unfortunately shown very little about what to expect from the new story. Taking place a couple of years after the events of Godzilla Minus One , now fans have gotten the first proper look at the sequel with a full trailer revealing the most details we have gotten about its new story thus far. You can check out the trailer for Godzilla Minus Zero below.

When Does Godzilla Minus Zero Come Out?

Godzilla Minus Zero is truly going to be a worldwide release in a way that no other Godzilla franchise film has done before. Toho and GKIDS are closely collaborating on its theatrical debut, and it’s going to release first in Japan on November 3rd. It’s then going to have a very quick turnaround for its international release as Godzilla Minus Zero will then be releasing across theaters in the United States and Canada on November 6th . That’s just proof positive that this is going to be a very big deal.

To further emphasize just how big of a deal this is going to be, Godzilla Minus Zero is also the first ever Japanese production to be fully filmed for IMAX. The film is going all out with the sequel as Takashi Yamazaki, director, screenwriter, and VFX supervisor for Godzilla Minus One , returns to oversee it all for Toho Studios with ROBOT producing and SHIROGUMI Inc. behind the visual effects. The director has been teasing fans about what’s next for the story , and the main thing he seems to emphasize is the fact that Godzilla returning after such a short time is ultimately going to be the most horrific element of it all.

What’s Godzilla Minus Zero About?

Godzilla Minus Zero takes place in 1949, two years after the events of Godzilla Minus One . Fans saw in that first film as Ryunosuke Kamiki’s Koichi Shikishima had been in the midst of a ruined Japan that was recovering from the effects of World War II. Godzilla’s sudden appearance only served to make things worse, and that’s likely going to be doubly the case for its return two years after the fact. But while they were able to subdue Godzilla before, it likely won’t be as easy the second time around.

We’re going to see other returning members of the first film’s cast, and it’s likely their lives are going to be also thrown into chaos once more with Minami Hamabe as Noriko Oishi, Hidetaka Yoshioka as Kenji Noda, Yuki Yamada as Shiro Mizushima, Kuranosuke Sasaki as Seiji Akitsu, Sakura Ando as Sumiko Ota, and Miou Tanaka as Tatsuo Hotta all confirmed thus far. There might even be another threat lingering in it all , so definitely keep an eye out this Fall when it hits.

title: Ace of the Diamond Act II Season 2 Cour 2 New Key Visual Teases Seido vs Inashiro Match Ahead of October 11 Premiere
content:
Ace of the Diamond Act II Season 2 revealed a new key visual for its second cour, set to continue with the Seido vs Inashiro match on October 11, 2026. Taking over from Madhouse is studio OLM, which is animating the sequel with Hideaki Oba as the director. The full staff includes:

• Director: Hideaki Oba

• Series Composition: Kenji Konuta

• Screenplay: Kenji Konuta, Junichi Fujisaku, Takahiro Udagawa

• Character Design: Yasukazu Shoji

• Music: Gen Ittetsu

• Art Director: Kenji Kato

• Director of Photography: Atsushi Sato (Studio Shamrock)

• Color Design: Nao Sato

• Editing: Toshihiko Kojima

• Animation Production: OLM Team Yoshioka

It was previously announced that GLAY will perform the opening theme, while OxT will perform the ending theme for the second cour. Both artists previously contributed songs to the anime.

Crunchyroll is streaming the anime, with thirteen episodes out so far. You can watch the trailer below.

The returning voice cast for the anime includes:

• Takahiro Sakurai as Kazuya Miyuki

• Ryota Osaka as Eijun Sawamura

• Natsuki Hanae as Haruichi Kominato

• Nobunaga Shimazaki as Satoru Furuya

• Shintaro Asanuma as Yoichi Kuramochi

• Yuma Uchida as Koshu Okumura

• Daiki Yamashita as Takuma Seto

• Shunsuke Takeuchi as Masashi Yuki

• Ayumu Murase as Kaoru Yui

• Tasuku Hatanaka as Hirofumi Asada

Ace of the Diamond is a Japanese baseball manga written and illustrated by Yuji Terajima. It was serialized in Kodansha’s Weekly Shonem Magazine from May 2006 to January 2015. The sequel titled Ace of the Diamond Act II started in August 2015 and ran until October 2022. The series also received a TV anime adaptation by Madhouse x Production I.G which ran from October 2013 to March 2016 for a total of 126 episodes. title: Magic Repo Man Anime Unveils New Trailer, Theme Songs, Additional Cast
content:
The new trailer for Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I’ll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest anime unveils the opening and ending theme songs of the series and an additional cast member. BUDDiiS performs the opening theme song “Risk rate,” while Kotani performs the ending theme song “Iremono.” Daisuke Namikawa joins the cast as Roger. SynergySP is animating the series slated to premiere on October 3.

Takahiro Tamano is directing, with Ryusuke Mori in charge of the series composition and Kazue Mori designing the characters. Ko Otani ( Shadow of the Colossus and Mobile Suit Gundam Wing ) is composing the music. A visual was released last June. The main cast includes:

• Reiji Kawashima as Lent

• Emiri Kato as Empee, the fairy companion

• Daiki Hamano as Guy

• Akira Sekine as Misa

• Yu Kobayashi as Elle

The anime is based on the manga by Shingo Iijima and original story by Masakichi. The story is introduced as follows: This is a world where a person’s life is greatly shaped by the “Gift” bestowed upon them by the Creator God. A kind-hearted boy named Lent, who lives in a remote frontier village, receives an exceedingly rare support-type ability called 《Mana Vault》, which allows him to lend his own magical power to his companions. Together with his childhood friends from the village, he forms the adventuring party “Skycleaver Sword” and sets out on a journey, determined to fulfill his role as the team’s support specialist. However, because Lent never seems to grow stronger himself, he comes to be seen as dead weight and is mercilessly expelled from the party. Consumed by intense anger and a desire for revenge, Lent’s Gift evolves, awakening its true power… A skill that allows him to forcibly reclaim the vast amounts of magical power he had been lending all along. Seizing back the mana from the former comrades who betrayed him, Lent grows stronger from what he recovers. Thus begins the tale of Lent’s revenge. Source: Official Website © Masakichi, Shingo Iijima, Flex Comix / “Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I’ll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest” Production Committee

title: Hotel Inhumans Season 2 Reveals New Visual, Trailer, Theme Songs
content:
The previously announced Hotel Inhumans Season 2 revealed a new visual and trailer featuring the opening and ending theme songs on Tuesday. GAN performs the opening theme song, “Rasen,” and Phantom Siita sings the ending theme song, “Sweet Pea.” The anime is slated to begin on October 4.

The cast includes:

• Yusuke Kobayashi as Ikuro Hoshi

• Hinano Shirahama as Sara Haizaki

• Hina Youmiya as Shiba Kirihara

The trailer is region-locked as of this writing.

Tetsuro Amino returns to direct the sequel with Shoji Yonemura handling the series composition, Shingo Fujisaka designing the characters, and Koharu composing the music. Studio Bridge and AISLE are animating the series.

The official website describes the synopsis as follows: The finest hotels meet certain conditions: “exquisite cuisine,” “supreme relaxation,” “enticing entertainment”… and “arrangement of the latest weapons,” “secure identity falsification,” “flawless body disposal”—!? At this hotel, the guests are assassins, and serving them is a concierge who will never say “NO.” What are the desires of these inhumans (those who are not truly human)—the assassins—expressed on the edge of life and death? The curtain rises on a striking killing-hotel drama!

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Third Opening Featuring "DIVE TO WORLD" by CHERRYBLOSSOM
content:
Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its third opening, featuring the song “DIVE TO WORLD” by CHERRYBLOSSOM. The song was used in Episodes 52-73, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.

The release follows yesterday’s release of the fourth ending featuring “friend” by IDOLING!!! . The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.

These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the second entry below.

The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.

The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The series also received an anime adaptation, which ran for 203 episodes from October 7, 2006 to September 25, 2010. Studio Artland handled the production. The anime is available on Crunchyroll , who describe the story: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!

title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden Anime's 2nd Video Unveils More Cast, Half-Year Run
content:
The staff for the television anime of Umikaze Minamino 's Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden ( Kyōran Reijō Nia Liston: Byōjaku Reijō ni Tenseishita Kami-goroshi no Bujin no Kareinaru Musō Roku ) light novel series revealed on Tuesday the anime's second promotional video, four more cast members, and its broadcast run of two consecutive cours (quarters of a year). The new video previews the previously announced opening theme song "Respawn!!" by VTuber Tsunomaki Watame.

The newly announced cast members are:

Kōichi Sakaguchi as Bendelio

Junichi Suwabe as Hyurence Altoire

Maaya Uchida as Sharro White

Kazuyuki Okitsu as Asuma

J-Novel Club releases the novels digitally and describes the story:

A great hero lies undefeated on her deathbed, regretting that she never found a foe who could take her down. She never intended to meet her fate anywhere other than on the battlefield, and her peaceful demise has her wishing desperately that things could have been different...But when she suddenly comes to in the body of the young, frail Nia Liston, she's got an all-new fight ahead of her. Nia is a sickly child, meaning she has a long way to go before she's in fighting form. Now that she's been given a second shot at life, however, she's determined to get what she wants. She's going to live—and die—for battle this time! Make way for the Merciless Maiden!

The anime stars:

• Honoka Inoue as Nia Liston

• Fūka Izumi as Rinokis Funk

• Rina Honnizumi as Hildetora Altoir

• Rina Hidaka as Reliared Silver

• Taku Yashiro as Anzel

• Yōko Hikasa as Fressa

• Satoshi Hino as Gandolf Rogen

Motoki Nakanishi ( Love Is Indivisible by Twins , Summoned to Another World for a Second Time ) is directing the anime at KONAMI animation with Haruta Segi as the assistant director. Gigaemon Ichikawa ( Himitsu no AiPri , PuniRunes three seasons) is in charge of series scripts, Yūki Itō ( Mob Psycho 100 II OAV key animator) and Kana Tosaoka ( Kantai Collection -KanColle- film in-between animator) are designing the characters. Naoki Endō ( Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club , Nijiyon Animation ) is composing the music, and Hiromi Kikuta ( Aikatsu! , Blue Period , Haikyu!! ) is directing the sound.

The additional staff members are:

• Color Key Artist: Ryōta Katsuta, Maki Yamamoto

• Art Setting: Barnstorm Design Labo

• Art Director: Hiroshi Gōroku

• Background Art: Makaria

• Compositing Director of Photography: Takashi Ōde

• Editing: Masayuki Kurosawa

The anime will premiere on October 6 on Tokyo MX at 9:25 p.m. JST, then on the BS NTV , and MBS channels, and will run for two consecutive cours . The anime will also stream on ABEMA , d Anime Store , and U-NEXT after its broadcast. HIDIVE will stream the anime as it airs. The anime will also hold an advance screening event for its first three episodes on September 22 at the esports TOKYO BAY studio.

Minamino launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in 2019, and ended its run there in 2021. Hobby Japan started publishing the novels with illustration by Jishaku in September 2022. Katana Canata started drawing the novels' illustration from its third volume in 2023. (The anime credits both illustrators for the original character designs.) Hobby Japan published the 11th volume on June 1.

Kabuto Kodai launched the novels' manga adaptation on Square Enix 's Manga UP! service in 2022. Square Enix published the manga's first compiled book volume in May 2023, and the eighth volume on February 6. Square Enix 's Manga UP! Global service publishes the manga in English.
